assertions: spawn原子写入ConversationOriginLink；启动恢复为旧ChildExecution补建稳定父对话lineage；并发同源spawn、重复dispatch/callback/reconcile按稳定identity收敛且不同请求不伪装dedupe
ChildExecution稳定ParentLink不随A continuation改写，B仍从旧Turn历史来源归属A树
interrupt_subtree用writer exact-set封住读写间并发spawn，重读稳定ParentLink后在同一成功事务覆盖全部active targets并取消pending Intent；请求本身不伪造Turn终态
A子树中断不误伤sibling/其他根树；叶节点interrupt_subtree只向该谱系当前ActiveTurnLink target写正常终止请求
父树登记interrupt_subtree后spawn在写入前拒绝，不留下半创建lineage
Plan winning commit是durable child intent；首次spawn后launch故障可幂等恢复，child已idle后的replay确认同一lineage且不重启
faults: spawn writer transaction fault after lineage/effect facts
concurrent identical spawn and duplicate callback

pending intent and active turns cancelled atomically
